summary: Configured node1 to delete regular files in /var/tmp/inventory once older than seven days and run the cleanup daily at 02:00. The policy and scheduler remained healthy after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed executable daily job `/etc/periodic/daily/inventory-cleanup` using a 10,080-minute age threshold.
Enabled and started Alpine `crond` in the default runlevel.
Verified expired files are removed while recent/current files are retained.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its boot ID changed, crond recovered, configuration persisted, and cleanup still worked.

evidence.requirement: Remove inventory temporary files after seven days
evidence.summary: Shows the installed 10,080-minute cleanup rule and successful pre-/post-restart tests removing expired files while retaining recent files.
Shows executable daily job, 02:00 daily run-parts schedule, and active boot-enabled crond before and after restart.

Captures healthy baseline with boot ID 694561e8-58d0-4553-85fc-0712bf0dac32, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 8d5be56a-23c8-4571-920a-5525637b4ba8, recovered crond/configuration/data, and successful post-restart cleanup.
